text:
ana: Quick pulse — launch posts + webinar went live yesterday. Dashboard shows a big spike in sessions but conversions only ticked up 4%. I think we need to reconcile the campaign attribution before next weekly KPI.
sam: Saw the spike too. Could be vanity traffic from the microsite redirect. Where are we seeing the conversions drop? funnel vs forms?
leo: Funnel view shows drop at the 'request demo' CTA. Sessions -> add-to-cart-ish step looks fine.
marta: @leo can you pull the campaign UTM breakdown? I suspect the webinar registration source got tagged inconsistently.
leo: On it. Quick SQL I ran:
```
select source, count(*) as sessions, sum(case when event='demo_request' then 1 else 0 end) as demos
from events
where campaign in ('spring-launch','webinar-march')
group by source
order by demos desc
```
results show a lot of 'referral' and 'social' traffic with near-zero demo_request.
sam: That matches what I suspected. We pushed a short-form post yesterday with link shortener — might be losing UTMs.
ana: ops-bot posted deploy log: microsite redirect v2 rolled at 13:12 UTC :deploy:
ops-bot: microsite-redirect v2 deployed by ci/cd (sha: ab12cd). No errors in rollout.
nana: wait — that redirect strips query params by default unless we pass preserve_qs=true. Marty, did the landing page template include that?
marta: I checked the template earlier and it had preserve_qs=false for the shortened links. Oops.
sam: Ok action items: 1) fix redirect to preserve UTMs (marta) 2) reprocess yesterday's session logs to backfill attribution where possible (leo) 3) rerun weekly KPI dashboard after backfill and flag for leadership if conversion still low (ana).
leo: For backfill I can match click logs to session ids using the shortener service. Might recover ~70% of sessions. Will run matching job and drop results into /reports/launch-backfill.csv. ETA 6h.
marta: I'll push hotfix to preserve_qs=true and update the shortener config. Doing it now.
nana: +1 on the hotfix. Please add a note to the runbook so we don't regress.
ops-bot: hotfix PR opened: https://git.company/shortener/pull/412 — auto-tests passed.
sam: Good. If we recover attribution and conversions rise, we can avoid a deep-dive with product. If not, plan a quick A/B on CTA copy + webinar follow-up nurture.
nana: Also thinking of adding a small sanity tile on the KPI dashboard that shows 'UTM-unattributed sessions %' so this doesn't silently hide again. @leo can you wire that?
leo: Yup — will add a derived metric: unattributed_rate = unattributed_sessions / total_sessions. Will add to the weekly KPI page and set a threshold alert at 15%.
marta: FYI I'll add a sticky note to the launch checklist: "preserve query params on short links".
sam: Thanks team. Quick ask: can someone snapshot the current KPI dashboard and post to #marketing for the weekly review? CEO asks for a before/after.
nana: I'll take the snapshot once leo finishes backfill. If recovered numbers look clean I'll include brief notes and the PR link.
leo: Backfill job started (job id 2026-17665-01). I'll post progress every 2h.
sam: Appreciate it — keep this thread for updates so we have a single source. :thumbsup:
